name: trademe-marketplace-scraper-input
title: Trade Me NZ Marketplace Scraper input

queries.title: Search terms
queries.description: Keywords to search for. Each term is walked to the end of its results, up to Max items.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Trade Me search, category or listing URLs. Listing URLs and bare IDs are always fetched in full.

category.title: Category ID
category.description: Optional Trade Me category number, e.g. 0344-0422-. Ignored when a URL already carries a category.

region.title: Region
region.description: Region name or ID, e.g. auckland.

district.title: District
district.description: District name or ID inside the region.

suburb.title: Suburb
suburb.description: Suburb name or ID inside the district.

buyNowOnly.title: Buy Now only
buyNowOnly.description: Keep only listings with a Buy Now price. Applied client-side (Trade Me ignores this filter server-side).

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Hard stop once this many listings are saved. 0 means unlimited.

maxPagesPerQuery.title: Max pages per query
maxPagesPerQuery.description: Page cap per search. Trade Me itself stops at 190 pages of 500.

fetchDetails.title: Fetch full details
fetchDetails.description: Fetch each listing's detail page for the description, full photo gallery and attributes. One extra request per listing.

incrementalMode.title: Incremental mode
incrementalMode.description: Remember the search and only emit new, changed or reappeared listings. Intended for scheduled runs.

stateKey.title: State key
stateKey.description: Baseline name for incremental mode. Leave empty to derive one from the search scope.

proxy.title: Proxy configuration
proxy.description: Datacenter proxy is sufficient. Switch to residential only if requests start being refused.
